evidence_quotes.O: Knowing that I would want to replace the SharpVision, I began doing research on projectors, starting in 2007.
evidence_quotes.C: after using it as much as possible to familiarize myself with it, I can report that, overall, I am very pleased with this unit.
evidence_quotes.E: Courtesy of Amazon Vine, I received my Dell Streak 7 Tablet and I have been having a lot of fun with it.
evidence_quotes.A: I can definitely and honestly say that it is an excellent unit, one of which Garmin should be proud.
evidence_quotes.N: (Still, 17 years is not a bad run!)
